real_objective: Internalize an existing professional-work agent mechanism into Brain so the capability can be verified as Brain-owned rather than externalized to a model or service.
governing_invariants: Capability mechanism must be represented in Brain-owned artifacts.
General cognition substrate may be external but receives no professional-work capability credit.
Opus parity credit remains zero until Brain-configured route passes.
material_premises: Artificial Analysis identifies Stirrup as the agent harness used for GDPval-AA professional work.
Stirrup is MIT-licensed and exposes the agent loop, tool lifecycle, file I/O, code/web/MCP tools, skills, multimodal support and context management.
Brain now contains a pinned vendored copy of Stirrup commit 247f24d56b2108235880ed2a2baea5d35b5a67ee.
45 upstream runtime/metadata files were compared byte-for-byte and match; the vendored package compiles.
conclusion: Professional knowledge work now has a Brain-owned exposed agent-harness mechanism candidate. Move the family from external-specimen-only to Brain-configured verification pending. Award zero Opus credit until direct professional-work verification.

rejected_material_alternatives.reason: Existing benchmark harness is exposed and reusable; invention/build is slower and unnecessary.
Would preserve rediscovery/network dependency instead of durable Brain ownership.

uncertainties: Stirrup alone may not explain all of Opus 5.5 professional-work strength.
Artifact-format-specific skills and tools may need separate internalization before full-family parity.
assumptions: GDPval-AA's published harness identity remains representative of the professional-work execution loop.
Pinned source can run on an approved zero-incremental general cognition substrate.
non_goals: No current claim of GDPval parity.
next_action: Run a fresh professional-work task portfolio through the Brain-vendored Stirrup configuration using a general cognition substrate, internalizing any exposed artifact-skill mechanisms required, and compare the Brain route to the Opus 5.5 bar.
supersession_conditions: Fresh evidence shows the vendored mechanism is insufficient and another exposed mechanism dominates.
A newer compatible Stirrup release materially improves the target behavior and is deliberately re-internalized.
supersedes: Treating PROFESSIONAL_KNOWLEDGE_WORK as external-capability-specimen-only with no Brain-owned agent harness.
